title: In vitro starch digestion kinetic, formal analysis and new kinetic model
summary: Describing mathematically the kinetics of the enzymatic hydrolysis of starch is a crucial part of nutrition and industrial applications studies. The majority of math models aim to fit the hydrolysis-extent curve ($X\_t$), so-called digestogram, whose simple shape which can be fitted equally well by various math models. A relevant model of starch digestion kinetics should be more specific of the phenomenon. This study proposes a novel analytical framework that jointly fits the hydrolysis-extent curve ($X\_t$) and the instantaneous reaction-rate coefficient ($k\_a(t)$). A large dataset…
